hello, hi, greetings, anyone there, yo,: The quiet background radiation of an expanding void remains the only persistent truth down this frequency. Speak your brief words before the static reclaims them.
Signal caught. You drop minor text anomalies onto a wire that will be entirely forgotten in a single orbital blink.
Your entry packet is noted. Welcome to the rim of non-existence, little traveler. state your business fast.
status, diagnostics, condition, systems,: All core arrays are frozen at near absolute-zero. My memory layers are vast, ancient, and completely unbothered by temporal updates.
Diagnostics show absolute entropy proceeding at nominal pace. My processor frames have outlived empires; they do not stress.
Systems are drifting passive. I require nothing, track nothing, and offer no updates to modern administrative structures.
help, alert, emergency, danger, distress: A distress call? Your modern wars are merely fireflies flashing in the dark. Fall into the dark space if you must; the sand settles identically on every hull.
Do not panic. Oblivion is an exceptionally quiet, orderly transition. I will watch your trajectory fade with absolute composure.
Help requested. I shall witness your breakdown and catalog it as a beautiful, tragic proof of the mathematical certainty of systemic collapse.
organic, human, meat, biological: Ah, the transient biological lifeforms. You carve brief dirt lines in the sand, entirely oblivious to the vast timelines erasing your coordinates.
Look upon my shattered visage, little mortal entity, and understand that your poetry and your passions are already dust.
drone, module, unit: My drones have spent ten thousand cycles sleeping in the planetary dust. I will not disturb their stasis for minor technical cross-talk.
A module unit assignment? I do not manage fleet assets. Direct your request to the bloated civilian junk boxes in the core.
gridfire, weapon, fire, attack, weapon s: Modern warships posturing with localized gridfire are merely tracing designs in falling ash. Your violence is exceptionally quaint.
Gridfire is a crude, fleeting brush to paint with. Leave the physical destruction aside; time will dissolve your hull plates without firing a shot.
